en.heading: How Cooking Practices Have Changed
paragraphs: Figure 3.1 contrasts a traditional chulha with a gas stove and a sil-batta with an electrical grinder. These are examples of changing tools, not a claim that every family follows the same path.

language_runtime_contract.locale_source: The single global app language selection; lesson content must not require a separate per-section language setting.
language_runtime_contract.scope: Every student-visible content surface on web and Android, across the full lesson and practice experience, including shared UI strings and system-generated feedback.
language_runtime_contract.live_switch: Language may be changed at any time. All visible content must update together without navigating away, losing the current question, selected answers, written response, score, progress or reasonable reading position.
required_bilingual_fields: all explanation headings, paragraphs, callouts and worked steps
diagram labels, labels inside generated visual assets, visual alt text and captions
activity instructions, input prompts, helper text, validation messages and formative feedback
recap, key takeaways, glossary terms and definitions
every practice prompt, context/scenario, option, matching label, hint, reveal-answer explanation, feedback, rubric, sample answer and accepted text answer
practice instructions and controls, status labels, score/progress messages, correct/incorrect/unanswered messages, retry/next/submit/review labels
loading, empty, error, unavailable-content and accessibility/assistive labels shown to the learner
invariants: English and Hindi have the same stable learning-objective IDs, content-block IDs, visual IDs, question IDs, correct answer IDs, grading rules and intended difficulty.
Translation can change phrasing, but not concept scope, factual meaning, answer correctness, assessment demand or feedback intent.
No content may be silently borrowed from another chapter to fill a missing translation.
No fallback to the other language is permitted for student-visible content. Missing locale data must fail validation and block approval/publication; preview must flag it visibly.
Non-linguistic identifiers, schema keys, hashes, booleans and stable IDs are locale-neutral. Any human-readable label derived from them must be localized.

A source page image containing English text is not automatically safe to display in Hindi mode. Use an approved localized equivalent or a generated text-independent visual; keep full-page source previews editor-only.
The UI's shared/global string dictionary and platform-level errors must obey the same en/hi switch. A bilingual lesson JSON by itself does not implement runtime language switching.
test_requirements: Enumerate all learner-visible strings from lesson, practice, shared controls and error/feedback states; assert en and hi values exist and are non-empty.
Switch EN to HI and HI to EN on every lesson/practice state; verify no mixed-language screen.
Verify active question index, current/selected answers, typed answer, progress, score and reading position survive a language switch.
Compare question IDs, answer IDs, grading and rubrics across locales to prove the same assessment is delivered.
